Several eligibility criteria are not captured in the profile or machine rule conditions.
The NRI upfront summary omits the separate ₹25,000 processing fee.
The OBC category display is not mapped to Gujarat’s SEBC label in the source packet.
The disability-centre count includes two appeal-board locations as certification centres.
The deposit recommendation copy claims every college although the engine checks sector and college type.

The guardian NRI option self-reports parents absent; the engine does not independently validate guardian documents.
